cross_item_assessment.novelty: Low: 16 items contain only eight scenarios, each reproduced with clause order reversed. Every item uses the same two-clause template, a nearby noun of the opposite number after 'near,' and one singular and one plural subject. The within-item choices are unique, but they vary only the two agreement endings.
cross_item_assessment.difficulty_effect: Standalone items merit level 2 because the learner must identify two subject heads across intervening noun phrases. In a set, repeated structure and the reversal pairs would make later answers easier through recognition, plausibly closer to level 1 in practice.
cross_item_assessment.recommendation: Revise the library for scenario and sentence-structure variety if 16 genuinely novel level-2 items are required. The current keys are unambiguous and the answer choices are distinct within every item.
